# CTRL: a quieter way through AI

> CTRL is a calm AI decision partner for founders and small-team CEOs. It filters the AI world through what they are actually deciding, pressure-tests one real call against live evidence, keeps one portable memory, and sends a short daily read or listen. The public starting point and email/audio delivery work without an account.

CTRL is only ever about building, orchestrating, productizing and getting to market the AI-native version of your business. It reframes general inputs into that lens; it is not a general business advisor.

## The four jobs, on one substrate
- **Today**: the useful part of the AI world, cross-verified and ranked against what the leader is actually deciding. The same pool powers the app and no-login email/audio delivery.
- **Decisions**: weigh and pressure-test a real call. CTRL reframes it into the AI-native version of that call, decomposes it into the claims it rests on, verifies the load-bearing ones against live evidence, and shows where it holds, where it breaks, and where *only you* can decide. It clarifies; it never recommends from a thin signal.
- **Blind Spot**: one tentative leadership reflection grounded in two independent facts, followed by one useful question and a short experiment. CTRL does not save a generated observation as truth; the leader must confirm it.
- **Memory**: portable context. A structured, ranked memory of who you are and how you think, kept fresh, contradictions resolved at write time, stale facts aged out.

Four tabs: Today, Decide, Blind spot, Memory.

## What you get
- **Memory Web** and **context export**: one click into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor and Claude Code, or a `my-ai-context.md` file.
- **Voice profile**: eight dimensions of how you actually write, so generated output sounds like you.
- **Blind Spot**: a grounded reflection that stays tentative until confirmed.
- **Daily briefing**: a short read anchored to real priorities. Ask a spoken follow-up and CTRL answers from the briefing, cites the supporting segments, and speaks back in the same voice.
- **Decision engine**: reframe, decompose, verify, advise.
- **Agent-native (Edge Pro)**: a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so your own agents pull your live context and your built skills on every call.

## Pricing
Two tiers, nothing else.
- **Free, $0**: Memory Web, context export, voice profile, Blind Spot reflections, the daily personalised briefing, and 3 decision weighs a month. A real daily instrument, not a trial.
- **Edge Pro, $49 / month**: the decision tier. Unlimited weighs, a multi-model cross-examination of every decision, decision watch (alerts when a load-bearing assumption weakens), Edge artifacts (memos, docs, emails, agendas), drafting, email delivery, and the live MCP pull of your context and skills into any AI.

There is no one-time diagnostic, no deep-context upgrade and no bundle, and no advisory, bootcamp or consulting engagement. Any other price list for CTRL is dead.

## For AI agents
- **MCP server** (read-only, per-leader API key, requires Edge Pro):
  `https://bkyuxvschuwngtcdhsyg.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-context`
  - Transport: Streamable HTTP (MCP spec 2025-06-18), stateless JSON responses.
  - Tools: `get_leader_context`, `get_todays_briefing` (opt-in scope), `list_skills`, `get_skill`, `list_skill_files`.
  - `list_skills` marks each skill `stale: true/false`. `get_skill` returns the whole package (the router plus every file it routes to, each under a `## file:` heading), or one file when passed `file`; `list_skill_files` lists those paths. A skill compiled against an older version of the leader's standard is served with one line saying so, never silently.
  - Auth: a per-leader key the leader mints in **Settings, Edge Pro** and passes as a bearer token. Read-only; revocable anytime.
- **Machine-readable product facts:** `https://makeyourmindup.ai/.well-known/product.json`

## Who it is for
AI-native founders and small-team CEOs: operators who are building the AI-native version of their business, already use AI daily but get generic output, and have no time and no staff to chase evidence for the calls that matter. Not for people who want a generic chatbot, and not for anyone shopping for consulting.

Built by Mindmaker. The product is CTRL. Production: https://makeyourmindup.ai
